title: the admin's money actions: refunds with the step-up, the rechecks, external refunds, the reconciliation screen and disputes

brief:
Give the owner the money actions the round 6, 7b and 9 functions already serve. Everything here is owner-only (operations and editors see none of it and call none of it), and every refusal shows the function's own Arabic message (`result.error.message`) unless this brief says otherwise. The orchestrator's design decisions below are final; no decoration, no icon, no new dependency.

1. The refund form, `src/components/admin/RefundView.tsx`, used by `OrderView` in its refunds section, for the owner, when the order has a `paid` attempt (the paying one) and the order is not `refunded`.
- One amount field per line that can still be refunded (`formatMoney` hint «المتبقي: <amount>»; the remainder is the line's total minus its refunded amount from `order_detail`), one for shipping (its remainder: the order's shipping minus the shipping allocated by the order's succeeded and in-flight refunds), a reason (required, 1 to 300 characters, one line), and, when the order has a `received` return with no refund linked, «ربط بطلب الإرجاع» (a select of those returns, optional). Amounts are typed in riyals and held as integer halalas (`src/lib/money-input.ts`); a field above its remainder or below zero is refused by the form under the field. The total is the sum, shown live; at least one positive amount is needed.
- «إعادة المبلغ» opens a confirmation step that repeats the total, the lines and the shipping, and says «سيُعاد المبلغ إلى وسيلة دفع العميل عبر Moyasar، ولا يمكن التراجع عنه.», with «تأكيد الاسترداد» and «رجوع». The confirmation mints the idempotency key (`crypto.randomUUID()`) once; that key and the exact body are kept for the step-up retry and for a retry after a network failure (so a repeat answers the stored refund and never reaches the provider twice); the key is discarded only when the owner changes the form or a final answer arrives.
- `refund-create` `{action, orderId, attemptId, amount, reason, allocation: {items: [{itemId, amount}] (only lines with an amount), shipping (only when above 0)}, idempotencyKey, returnId?}`. `STEP_UP_REQUIRED` → the `StepUp` dialog → the same body once. A 200 reply is parsed strictly as `{refundId, status, amount}`: `succeeded` «تمت إعادة <amount>.»; `uncertain` «أُرسل الاسترداد ولم يتأكد بعد؛ تتحقق منه المطابقة خلال دقائق.»; `failed` «رفضت بوابة الدفع الاسترداد؛ لم يُخصم شيء.»; `submitting` like uncertain. `PROVIDER_AHEAD` shows its message and, beside it, the external-refund button below. After any answer the order is read again.
- A review payment of the order (and, on the reconciliation screen, one that has no order) gets «استرداد هذه الدفعة» for the owner while it is not closed as refunded: amount (at most its amount minus its refunded total), reason, the same confirmation, `refund-create` with `reviewPaymentId`, `orderId` only when the payment has one, `allocation: {}`.

2. The rechecks and the external refund, owner only.
- «أعد الفحص» on each attempt in `OrderView`'s payment section and on the reconciliation screen: `payment-recheck` `{action, attemptId}`; the reply `{status}` is shown with its label («الحالة الآن: <label>»), then the data is read again.
- «أعد الفحص» on each in-flight refund (`submitting`, `uncertain`): `refund-recheck` `{action, refundId}`; the reply `{refundId, status, amount}` worded as above.
- «تسجيل استرداد خارجي» for the paying attempt and for a review payment: the sentence «سجّل هنا استردادًا أو إلغاءً تمّ من لوحة Moyasar؛ يُقرأ المبلغ من Moyasar نفسها.», a reason (1 to 300), then `refund-record-external` `{action, attemptId | reviewPaymentId, reason}` through the step-up; `NO_DELTA` shows its message.
- The order's webhook events in `OrderView` (the orchestrator's ruling on round 11a's R11A-4: contract section 6 lists them among what the order screen shows, as verified evidence): under «الدفع», a list «إشعارات الدفع» from `order_detail`'s `events`: type and outcome as codes (`dir="ltr"`), received and processed times (`formatRiyadh`), attempts, and the error code; «لا توجد إشعارات.» when there are none; visible to owner and operations, read-only (dismissing an exhausted one is the reconciliation screen's).

3. `/admin/orders/reconciliation` (`.../orders/reconciliation/page.tsx` around `src/components/admin/ReconciliationView.tsx`), owner only; operations and editors see «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول» and make no call. From `reconciliation_list()` and `disputes_list()`:
- «محاولات تحتاج فحصًا»: order number (a link to the view), status, amount, the provider ids, the reasons (UNCERTAIN «إنشاء غير مؤكد», UNVERIFIED «لم يُتحقق منها», PROVIDER_STATUS «حالة مختلفة لدى Moyasar», EXTERNAL_REFUND «استرداد لدى Moyasar غير مسجّل»), «أعد الفحص», and for EXTERNAL_REFUND «تسجيل استرداد خارجي».
- «دفعات قيد المراجعة» (open ones): reason label, amount, refunded, order number or «بلا طلب», «إغلاق المراجعة» (the round 11a control: `review_close`) and «استرداد هذه الدفعة».
- «استردادات قيد المعالجة»: order number, amount, status, created, error code, «أعد الفحص».
- «إشعارات الدفع»: type, received time, payment id, outcome, attempts, error; an `exhausted` one gets «تمت المراجعة» with the sentence «بعد مراجعتها في لوحة Moyasar.» → `event_dismiss(p_event)`.
- «النزاعات»: each reference with its rows in order (kind «اعتراض بطاقة» chargeback, «فرق تحويل» payout_difference, «فرق رسوم» fee_difference, «أخرى» other; direction «على البائع» against_seller, «لصالح البائع» for_seller; decision «بلا إجراء» none, «سحب الملفات» entitlement_revoked, «إبقاء الملفات» entitlement_kept, «إيقاف الشحن» fulfillment_stopped), and per reference «إضافة متابعة».
- Empty lists say «لا شيء هنا.»; the silent caps of the SQL (100 per list) are stated when a list reaches 100: «تُعرض أحدث 100.».

4. The dispute form, `src/components/admin/DisputeForm.tsx`, through `dispute-record` and the step-up. Opened from three places: the reconciliation screen's «تسجيل فرق» (kinds `payout_difference`, `fee_difference`, no target); `OrderView`'s paying attempt «تسجيل اعتراض» (kind `chargeback` or `other`, target that attempt, the order's lines available for the item decisions); a review payment's «تسجيل اعتراض» (target that payment). «إضافة متابعة» opens it with the reference, kind and target of the reference's first row and `follows` = its latest seq, none of them editable. Fields: reference (1 to 120, `dir="ltr"`), amount in riyals (> 0), direction, the day (`<input type="date">`, not after today in Riyadh), reason (1 to 500), resolution (optional, up to 500), decision, and the lines (checkboxes) only when the decision is `entitlement_revoked` or `fulfillment_stopped` (then at least one). A 201 says «سُجّل.», a 200 with `duplicate: true` «هذا السجل مسجّل من قبل؛ لم يتغير شيء.»; both re-read the lists. The form never offers to create a refund.

5. Links: the «تحتاج مطابقة: n» count on `/admin/orders` and on the home becomes a link to `/admin/orders/reconciliation` (owner only); `/admin/orders` gains a plain link «المطابقة» for the owner. `scripts/check-export.mjs`: add `admin/orders/reconciliation.html`.

6. Rules for every action here: the button is disabled while its call is in flight; one `role="status"` and one `role="alert"` line per screen, mounted before they are filled, the focus to the line that reports the result; nothing optimistic (the screen shows what the re-read data says); a reply that fails its strict parser says «تعذّر قراءة الرد؛ حدّث الصفحة.» and the data is read again (a money action is never assumed to have failed or succeeded from a bad reply). No amount is ever computed in floating point.

7. Tests.
- `tests/unit/admin-money.test.ts` (new): the remainders (a line partly refunded, shipping already allocated by a succeeded and by an in-flight refund), the allocation built from the fields (only positive lines, shipping only when above 0, the total equal to the sum), the refusal of an amount above its remainder, the idempotency key kept across a step-up retry and a network retry and renewed after a change (test the pure state helper you write for it), the strict parsers of the three replies.
- `tests/e2e/orders-money.spec.ts` (new), each test at 360 and 1440. Real sign-in and a real TOTP enrolment (the owner-operations way), real step-up dialogs. The `admin` function's replies are mocked with `page.route` on `**/functions/v1/admin` (the real refund journey against the emulator is round 12's): the request body of `refund-create` asserted exactly (items, shipping, the key, the return), `STEP_UP_REQUIRED` then the same body with the same key, each of `succeeded`, `uncertain`, `failed`, `PROVIDER_AHEAD` (the external button appears), `EXCEEDS_BALANCE`, a network failure then a retry with the same key, a double press sending one request, the review payment refund with `allocation: {}`, both rechecks, the external refund through the step-up, the reconciliation screen's every section from a mocked `reconciliation_list` and `disputes_list` (the Data API, `**/rest/v1/rpc/...`) including the 100 cap sentence, `event_dismiss`, a dispute recorded (201) and repeated (200 duplicate), a follow-up's locked fields and `follows`, the item decision needing lines; an operations member and an editor refused the reconciliation screen and seeing no money action in the order view (real data from the round 11a seed). Screenshots of the refund form, its confirmation, the reconciliation screen and the dispute form at both widths, no horizontal page overflow.
- Run `tests/e2e/orders-admin.spec.ts` in full: `OrderView` changed.

Run the dev server only through Playwright's own webServer. Before any e2e run check that at least 10 GB of memory is free; if not, stop leftover headless Chrome processes, and if it is still short report it and skip the e2e run. Copy `next-env.d.ts` aside before an e2e run or a build and restore it after; if `pnpm typecheck` then fails with TS1128 in `.next/e2e`, remove `.next/e2e`.

Never open, read or print a .env file (the repository's, `.env.local` or `supabase/functions/.env`), not even to derive a test value; the test helpers already load what a test needs.

auditFocus: Money: can the form send more than a remainder, a float, a zero or negative amount, an allocation whose sum differs from the amount, or a refund of a review payment with an allocation; can a double press, a step-up retry, a network retry or a reload create a second refund (the idempotency key's life, end to end); is anything treated as refunded before the function said so; is a bad reply ever read as success or failure. The request bodies against the three zod schemas field by field (`strictObject`: an extra key is a 422). Roles: no money control, no reconciliation call, for operations or an editor. The confirmation step: the total and lines repeated, irreversible said, nothing sent before «تأكيد الاسترداد». The dispute form: never a refund, follow-ups locked to their reference's target, the day bounded, the item decisions needing lines. The rechecks: no TOTP, owner only, the data re-read. Accessibility at 360 and 1440: labels, regions, focus after each result, the dialog's focus return. The tests: request bodies asserted, every reply state reached, both widths, owner and non-owner.
